answer: Retiring an identity early forfeits 33% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the nectar forfeiture reveals up in the fable totals with the mesa audit listing each retired key. An operator that abandons 74 aliases after a single epoch as a result destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
